div.ab: CXIII. Sceap sceal gongan mid his flyse oð midne sumor; oððe gilde ðæt flys mid II penegum.
CXIII. Sceap sceal gongan mid his fliese oð midne sumor; oððe gilde þæt flies mid twam pæningum.
Ouis debet ire cum uellere suo usque ad mediam estatem; aut persoluatur ipsum uellus II denariis.
{CXIII} Sceap sceal gongan mid his fliese oð midne sumor; oððe gilde þæt flies mid twam pæningum.
A sheep must go with its fleece until mid-summer, or the fleece must be recompensed with two pennies.
A sheep shall retain its fleece until midsummer. [If it is sheared before then], 2 pence shall be paid for the fleece.
A sheep must go with its fleece until midsummer, or else the fleece is to be paid for at twopence.
Ein Schaf soll mit seinem Vliess bis Mittsommer gehen; oder [wer es geschoren veräussert] ersetze das Vliess mit 2 Pfennigen.
A sheep is to go with its fleece until midsummer; or [whoever sells it shorn] let him make good the fleece with 2 pence.
